posts.text: Regarding the Satin Creditcare Q2FY27 Business update, there are many good points . In my view, the best is asset quality improvement is the strongest positive point. The reduction in standalone GNPA from 3.5% to 1.9% is really good. This suggests that the company is not simply growing its loan book, it is also improving in collections .
